3281.title: Resolved provider identities remain queued as fallbacks
3281.rootCauseOneLine: Recording an explicit provider identity does not remove its bb thread from the pending fallback queue, allowing a later unmatched identity to overwrite the mapping while event stamping preserves the original checkpoint.
3281.proposedFix: Remove a thread from the pending identity queue whenever its explicit provider identity is recorded, then cover the stale-fallback overwrite with the focused regression.
3281.caveats: The registry mismatch was reproduced twice; the live provider notification sequence and reported UI edit failure were not reproduced.
